title: Zheng Qinwen Wins the China Open, Then Sings Karaoke
summary:
Tennis star Zheng Qinwen made history in Beijing. She became the first Chinese woman to win the China Open. She beat Mirra Andreeva without losing a set.

After winning, the 24-year-old fell to the court. Then, after her speech, she sang karaoke for the cheering home crowd!

"To win here in Beijing in front of my home crowd is one of my dreams," Zheng said.

It had been a hard year for her. She had elbow surgery last year and had not won a title in two years. This was the sixth title of her career.

Andreeva, who is 19, was ahead early in both sets, but Zheng fought back. Zheng won the match with an ace, a serve her opponent could not touch.

"Finally, after so many losses, I [found] my fire again," Zheng said.

Zheng is set to jump 31 spots to number 23 in the world rankings.
why_it_matters: Zheng's win shows kids that working hard after a tough time can help you reach your dreams.
